Descriptive Translation Studies 
This chapter will locate the present study within the framework for translation studies 
proposed by Holmes (1988) and which has been developed by Toury (1995) into a 
method for descriptive translation studies. It will consider the concept of norms in 
translation, look at previous descriptive studies and describe how the different 
elements in the translation process fit together in a systemic relationship. 
1.1 The Holmes/Toury `map' 
Holmes's influential paper `The Name and Nature of Translation Studies' (Holmes 
(1988: 67-80), a revised version of a 1972 original), which Gentzler (1993: 92) 
describes as `generally accepted as the founding statement for the field', attempts to 
set out a general framework for translation studies as an empirical discipline. This
